title: [Main]Posting Error with 50% Non-Deductible VAT when "Check Source Currency Consistency" is enabled in "General Ledger Setup" page
summary: Fixed a posting error that occurred when posting purchase documents with 50% non-deductible VAT in a foreign currency while source currency consistency checking was enabled. The source currency VAT amount for deductible VAT entries now correctly excludes the non-deductible portion.
key_points: Posting with partial non-deductible VAT and foreign currency now succeeds when source currency consistency checking is enabled
Source currency VAT amount for deductible VAT entries adjusted to exclude non-deductible VAT portion
Fixes unbalanced general ledger source currency totals that previously triggered consistency validation errors
Changes applied across all regional and base application variants
quote: Posting Error with 50% Non-Deductible VAT when "Check Source Currency Consistency" is enabled in "General Ledger Setup" page
